name: PeMSD8 (PeMS-08)
description: A multivariate traffic time-series forecasting dataset derived from California Department of Transportation Performance Measurement System (PeMS) data. It contains traffic measurements from 170 sensors in the San Bernardino area, aggregated at 5-minute intervals over July–August 2016. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Guo, S., Lin, Y., Feng, N., Song, C., and Wan, H. (2019). Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Traffic Forecasting. Proceedings of the Twenty-Eighth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-19), 3634–3640. https://doi.org/10.24963/ijcai.2019/505

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms; not a standard SPDX license identifier
license.notes: The PeMSD8 data is derived from Caltrans PeMS. No standard SPDX license identifier for this processed dataset is established here; consult Caltrans and the dataset distributor's terms before use or redistribution. This record vendors no data.
